<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844" width="390" height="844">

  <rect x="0" y="44" width="390" height="277" fill="#108EE9"/>
  <circle cx="338" cy="84" r="70" fill="#3199E4" opacity="0.45"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="260" r="86" fill="#0E467A" opacity="0.16"/>

    <rect x="24" y="76" width="76" height="48" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="45" cy="100" r="12" fill="#108EE9"/>
    <circle cx="45" cy="100" r="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="57" y="94" width="27" height="4" rx="2" fill="#108EE9"/>
    <rect x="57" y="102" width="19" height="4" rx="2" fill="#108EE9"/>
  </g>
  <text x="24" y="180" font-family="General Sans, sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Selamat Datang</text>
  <text x="24" y="221" font-family="General Sans, sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">kembali!</text>
  <text x="24" y="264" font-family="General Sans, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#B2C6FE">Masuk dengan nomor ponsel Anda</text>

  <!-- Main form card shadow -->
  <rect x="16" y="294" width="358" height="404" rx="16" fill="#000000" opacity="0.10"/>
  <rect x="16" y="288" width="358" height="404" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <text x="40" y="329" font-family="General Sans, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="500" fill="#222741">Masuk ke akun DANA</text>
  <text x="40" y="354" font-family="General Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#75788D">Masukkan nomor ponsel yang terdaftar</text>

  <!-- Phone label -->
  <text x="40" y="388" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#222741">Nomor ponsel</text>
  
  <!-- Phone input -->
  <rect x="40" y="399" width="310" height="56" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DCDDDF" stroke-width="1"/>

  <rect x="52" y="411" width="48" height="16" rx="6" fill="#E84B4B"/>

  <text x="180" y="434" font-family="General Sans, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#ACAEBE">812 3456 7890</text>

  <text x="40" y="478" font-family="General Sans, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#75788D">Pastikan nomor ponsel Anda masih aktif</text>

  <g>
    <rect x="40" y="504" width="310" height="56" rx="12" fill="#108EE9"/>

  <circle cx="53" cy="594" r="10" fill="#E3F2F6"/>

  <text x="72" y="599" font-family="General Sans, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#75788D">Data Anda terlindungi dengan aman</text>

  <line x1="40" y1="626" x2="350" y2="626" stroke="#EFEFEF" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="195" y="657" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#75788D">Belum punya akun?</text>
  <text x="195" y="680" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#108EE9">Daftar sekarang</text>

  <rect x="0" y="748" width="390" height="96" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <g>
    <polygon points="39,775 50,766 61,775" fill="none" stroke="#75788D" stroke-width="2"/>

    <text x="50" y="814" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#75788D">Beranda</text>
  </g>
  <!-- Aktivitas -->
  <g>
    <rect x="125" y="766" width="20" height="20" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#75788D" stroke-width="2"/>

    <line x1="130" y1="778" x2="140" y2="778" stroke="#75788D" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="135" y="814" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#75788D">Aktivitas</text>
  </g>
  <!-- Bantuan -->
  <g>
    <rect x="207" y="766" width="22" height="17" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#75788D" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="211,783 211,789 217,783" fill="#75788D"/>
    <text x="218" y="814" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#75788D">Bantuan</text>
  </g>
  <!-- Profil -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="316" cy="772" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#75788D" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="316" cy="784" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#75788D" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="316" y="814" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#75788D">Profil</text>
  </g>
</svg>
